description: As a fleet manager, I want to update aircraft operational status using a dropdown so that the fleet board reflects the current state of each aircraft.

acs.text: The status dropdown displays exactly three options: Active, Grounded, and In Maintenance.
When the status is changed to Grounded, a mandatory reason text field appears below the dropdown.
The status change is recorded in the aircraft audit trail with a timestamp and the user who made the change.
